# Hisdayspring Ministries International

> Raising holy, healthy and wealthy people with a sense of dominion and world evangelism by the power of the Holy Spirit. A Pentecostal church in Lagos, Nigeria with branches in Ipaja, Island Church and Ikorodu.

Services: Sundays 8:00 AM, 10:00 AM & 12:00 NOON. Phone: +234-906-619-2155. Email: hello@hisdayspring.org.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.hisdayspringfamily.org/): service times, ministries, events, gallery and contact.
- [Meet Our Pastors](https://www.hisdayspringfamily.org/pastors): lead pastors, branch pastors and ministers.
- [Giving](https://www.hisdayspringfamily.org/giving): tithes, offerings and seeds online by card or bank transfer, plus pastor & ministerial giving sent directly to the pastor's own bank account.
- [Ministries](https://www.hisdayspringfamily.org/ministries/yofic): youth ministry (YOFIC), and other church ministries.
- [Events](https://www.hisdayspringfamily.org/#events): conferences, crusades and special services.
- [Live Stream](https://www.hisdayspringfamily.org/live): watch Sunday services live on YouTube.
- [Radio](https://www.hisdayspringfamily.org/radio): Hisdayspring radio stream.
- [Books](https://www.hisdayspringfamily.org/books): publications by Pastor Blessing Olamijulo. Order online by card or bank transfer and pick up in church (show your payment reference at the bookstand), or choose PDF copies for instant download. Bookstand staff confirm paid orders at www.hisdayspringfamily.org/books/verify.
- [Welfare](https://www.hisdayspringfamily.org/welfare): community welfare and outreach programmes.
- [Crusade](https://www.hisdayspringfamily.org/crusade): Healing From Heaven crusade information.
- [Testimonies](https://www.hisdayspringfamily.org/testimonials): testimonies of transformed lives.
- [Prayer Requests](https://www.hisdayspringfamily.org/prayer): submit a prayer request via WhatsApp.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.hisdayspringfamily.org/privacy): how we handle personal data.
